children: Beam Global entered a non-binding LOI to acquire a European drone technology company and intends to onshore manufacture of a conditionally approved drone in the U.S.
Signed a non-binding letter of intent to acquire a vertically integrated European drone and AI-software company.
Target’s drone has U.S. Department of War Conditional Approval; Beam plans U.S. manufacturing to satisfy onshoring.
FCC exempted the product from its Covered List, enabling U.S. sales subject to continued approvals.
Beam expects to sell drones and software across its global customer base, including defense and commercial clients.
Transaction remains subject to due diligence, negotiation of definitive agreements and customary closing conditions.

title: Beam Global signs LOI to acquire European drone firm, aims to onshore U.S. drone manufacturing
